description: Append a timestamped task action, architectural decision, or observation to episodic history, returning the stored episode metadata. Use for chronological event logs; use `oxyo_remember_belief` instead for standing rules or facts.

content.description: Concise summary of the completed action, decision, or technical observation.

importance.description: Base retention priority score between 0.0 (trivial) and 1.0 (critical milestone).

kind.description: Event category ('action' for changes made, 'observation' for findings, 'user' for requests).

scope.description: Project/repo scope where this episode applies (defaults to 'global').

use_neural_salience.description: Automatically calibrate retention priority based on novelty and information density.

name: oxyo_remember_episode
